confirmed_matches.label: thyroepiglottic part of thyroarytenoid muscle
confirmed_matches.uberon_definition: Fibers of the thyroarytenoid muscle that continue to the margin of the epiglottis; it closes the inlet to the larynx.
confirmed_matches.wikipedia_summary: The thyroepiglottic muscle (pars thyroepiglottica musculi thyroarytenoidei) is a fasciculus of the thyroarytenoid muscle whose fibers prolong backward and upward to the lateral margin of the epiglottis; some of its fibers spread out on the anterior surface of the arytenoid cartilage. It depresses the epiglottis and helps close the laryngeal inlet during swallowing.
